0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Tio-Reeq is wrinkling his nose in displeasure.

24.original: Pick bunches of Kholusian sage near the Clave.

25.original: Deliver the bunches of Kholusian sage to Tio-Reeq.

26.original: Use the sachet of Kholusian sage at the designated location.

48.original: Ugh... Oh, my poor, sensitive nose! Do you not smell that awful <hex:021A020203>stench<hex:021A020103>!?

49.original: What we require here is a strategically placed sachet of ground Kholusian sage. The trouble is, I'm not quite willing to die in the process of obtaining said herb.

50.original: But what of you, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>? There is sage aplenty near the Clave should the promise of reward overshadow any fear you might have of stabbing tooth and rending claw. Two generous bunches should suffice!

51.original: You'll find patches of sage over to the west, near the Clave. Two large handfuls of the herb would be most appreciated!

53.original: Yes, this is a goodly amount. My thanks! A moment while I prepare an experimental sachet...

54.original: I'll just grind these up...add a sprinkle of this...a dash of that...

56.original: <sniff> Ah, 'tis akin to inhaling a springtime breeze! I must begin producing these fair-scented pouches in bulk!

57.original: You, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, have the privilege of putting my aromatic creation to the test. Place one of my sachets behind this foul-smelling shack, and inform me of the results!

58.original: A proper test of my sachets is in order! And the backside of this malodorous lean-to should provide the perfect testing ground!

59.original: The rank fumes permeating the air are slowly replaced by a pleasant, refreshing scent...

60.original: Did my sachet prove the victor in that contest of fragrances?

61.original: Well, that is satisfying to hear! I shall continue manufacturing these pockets of sage and proceed with secreting them about the place.

62.original: The thing of it is, the folk of Gatetown often paw through the refuse discarded by the free citizens of Eulmore.

63.original: Such salvaged items have, however, spent no short span of time moldering amongst actual garbage... Thus the offensive odor I have been forced to endure. But no longer!

64.original: Thanks to you, my olfactory senses will be spared. Pray accept this token for your trouble!
